text:
Carlos (AR): Heads-up: MapleHealth (acct: MAPLE-22) invoice INV-6021 bounced on card auth this morning. Customer notes their corporate card expired and treasury asks for ACH instructions. Support ticket #9538 created.

Lena (Support): Customer said they can do ACH but their treasury needs confirmation on beneficiary name + routing format. They asked if we support international USD wires too.

Nina (Payments): Stripe event shows `invoice.payment_failed` with `last_payment_error`: `expired_card`. Card last4=1111. Our retry cadence is immediate, +24h. For ACH: it takes micro-deposits (2-3 days) unless they use same-bank instant ACH (rare). If they need immediate access, wire is faster.

Jules (FinOps): If they opt for wire, we should send redacted bank PDF via secure link. For ACH we can provide instructions but warn about micro-deposit timing. Also recommend temporary credit hold removal if they provide PO or e-mail confirmation.

Carlos (AR): Can we offer a "one-time card update" link as well? Sometimes they can update card in the portal and pay instantly. If treasury is slow, wire is fallback.

Lena (Support): They're checking with treasury: prefer ACH but asking how long until services would be suspended.

Nina (Payments): Policy: 72-hour grace before suspension for enterprise customers if a support/AR contact is engaged. We can extend to 5 days on case-by-case. For this account, we have an active SOW; recommend grace extension and send payment options. @Jules authorize?

Jules (FinOps): Authorized: extend grace to 5 days, set invoice flag `awaiting_payment_method`. Disable auto-dunning. Prepare both ACH and wire docs.

payments-bot: Note added to INV-6021: "payment failed: expired_card; customer requested ACH info; AR extended grace to 5d. ticket 9538."

Nina (Payments): Draft instructions (redacted) to paste in support reply:
```
Option A - ACH (USD domestic):
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference LLC
Bank: Union Central Bank (US)
Routing (ACH): 222000XXX (redacted)
Account (last4): ****4321
Remittance: INV-6021 / MAPLE-22
Note: ACH micro-deposits 48-72 hours for verification.

Option B - Wire (faster):
SWIFT/BIC: UCBBUS33XXX
ABA: 222000YYY (redacted)
Account: ****4321 (last4)
Reference: INV-6021 / MAPLE-22
```

Carlos (AR): Please don't paste full account numbers here. Upload full PDF to secure://payments/wires and send link in ticket.

Lena (Support): Uploading now. Will include both options and clear timing.

Nina (Payments): Uploaded secure://payments/wires/maplehealth_INV-6021_payment-options_redacted.pdf. Sent secure link to customer. Scheduling one automated retry in 4 hours (per our new retry policy for expired cards).

Carlos (AR): If they choose ACH and we need to validate micro-deposits, set a reminder on the ticket to confirm in 72h. If they wire, match remittance to invoice and mark paid ASAP.

Jules (FinOps): Also note: if they update card via portal and pay, cancel wire instruction to avoid dupes. If they request a pro-forma invoice for treasury, billing can generate.

Nina (Payments): For records, webhook sample (sanitized):
```json
{ 
  "id": "evt_1Kyyyyyy",
  "type": "invoice.payment_failed",
  "data": {
    "object": {
      "id": "in_2Gyyyyy",
      "customer": "cus_MapleHealth",
      "last_payment_error": {
        "code": "expired_card",
        "payment_method": {
          "card": {
            "last4": "1111",
            "exp_month": 1,
            "exp_year": 2024
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Lena (Support): Customer replied: treasury prefers ACH; will initiate micro-deposit verification today. They'll update ticket once verified.

Carlos (AR): Great. I'll leave the invoice in `awaiting_payment_method`. Will set reminder for 72h.

Jules (FinOps): Thanks team. Keep notes in ticket and tag me if we need to escalate or issue temporary credit.

Lena (Support): Closing loop for now, will reopen if customer asks for wire or needs pro-forma. :white_check_mark:
